owned_invariants: The task is the XOR task and optionally max_attempts, an exact integer from 1 to 8; without it the limit is 3.

After a rejected attempt the next prompt is the task as written, that attempt's residual, and a hint: the numbers of the fundamental cycles still odd and, for each, the names of its vertices in ascending order. Only the latest residual and hint are carried.
The hint is built from the residual and the graph alone. It never names an edge to flip. For a reply the host could not read it is empty.

When the residual of an attempt equals the residual of the attempt three earlier, the run stops and is refused as STATIONARY_LOOP on the failed predicate residual_not_stationary, with the turn, the turn it repeats, the residual and the hint. No other distance is compared.
A reply the host cannot read is never taken as a repeat.
The run is certified on the first accepted attempt, as ACCEPTED_FIRST_TRY or REPAIRED. Reaching the limit or a missing reply is refused as TURN_CAP_EXHAUSTED.
boundaries: A proposer that cycles with a period other than 3 is not detected; it runs to the limit.
The stop needs at least four attempts, so it can only fire when the task allows four or more.
The vertices of an odd cycle are public structure, and they narrow where a wrong label can be.

score.level_basis: Typed refusals on every failure path, closed requests, exact unbounded integers and rationals, no float, no unwrap or expect.
